## Summary

Generate MS figures for species and functional turnover:

* Spp and FE dissimilarity due to extirpation and colonization


## Data

* AquaX species distribution models from Reygondeau et al. (2026). AquaX: An enhanced and revised AquaMaps framework to model marine species distributions and biodiversity. PLOS ONE, 21(2), e0335823. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0335823
* Function entities from O'Hara et al. (2024). Cumulative human impacts on global marine fauna highlight risk to biological and functional diversity. PLOS ONE, 19(9), e0309788. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0309788

## Methods

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(collapse)
library(cowplot)

source(here('scripts/common_fxns.R'))
```

### Read in and rasterize turnover metrics

These rasters were created in scripts 1 (spp turnover) and 2 (fe turnover) in the Behrmann projection.

```{r read rasts}

spp_turn_r <- rast(here('_output/spp_turnover_maps/all_spp_turnover.tif'))
fe_turn_r  <- rast(here('_output/fe_turnover_maps/all_fe_turnover.tif'))

# plot(spp_turn_r); plot(fe_turn_r)
```

## Generate Manuscript Figures

### Map of turnover by component

Break turnover into extirpation and colonization components, plot as 4-panel.

```{r spp and fe turnover components}
fig_file <- here('ms_figs/fig2_spp_fe_turnover_components.png')

if(!file.exists(fig_file)) {
  turnover_rasts <- c(spp_turn_r[['rcp45_2050']], fe_turn_r[['rcp45_2050']])

  spp_turn_ext_r <- rast(here('_output/spp_turnover_maps/all_spp_turnover_extirp.tif'))
  fe_turn_ext_r  <- rast(here('_output/fe_turnover_maps/all_fe_turnover_extirp.tif'))

  extirp_rasts <- c(spp_turn_ext_r[['rcp45_2050']], fe_turn_ext_r[['rcp45_2050']]) %>%
    setNames(c('SpeciesXExtirpation', 'FEXExtirpation'))
  coloniz_rasts <- (turnover_rasts - extirp_rasts) %>%
    setNames(c('SpeciesXColonization', 'FEXColonization'))

  turn_component_rasts <- c(extirp_rasts, coloniz_rasts)

  turn_comp_df <- as.data.frame(turn_component_rasts, xy = TRUE) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(x, y), names_to = 'var', values_to = 'val') %>%
    fmutate(unit = sub('X.+', '', var),
            comp = sub('.+X', '', var)) %>%
    fmutate(unit = factor(unit, levels = c('Species', 'FE')),
            comp = factor(comp, levels = c('Extirpation', 'Colonization')))

  spp_fe_turn_comp_plot <- plot_map(data = turn_comp_df, fill_var = val, lat_color = 'grey70') +
    scale_fill_viridis_c() +
    theme(text = element_text(family = 'Helvetica'),
          strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 90),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.text = element_blank(), 
          axis.title = element_blank(),
          panel.spacing.x = unit(.6, 'cm')) +
    facet_grid(unit ~ comp, switch = 'y') +
    labs(fill = expression(beta[.Sør]))

  ### Add panel letters
  p_out <- ggdraw() +
    draw_plot(spp_fe_turn_comp_plot, x = 0.005, y = 0, height = 1, width = .99) +
    draw_label('A', x = 0.00, y = 0.95, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, 
               fontface = 'bold', fontfamily = 'Helvetica', size = 12) +
    draw_label('B', x = 0.46, y = 0.95, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, 
               fontface = 'bold', fontfamily = 'Helvetica', size = 12) +
    draw_label('C', x = 0.00, y = 0.47, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, 
               fontface = 'bold', fontfamily = 'Helvetica', size = 12) +
    draw_label('D', x = 0.46, y = 0.47, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, 
               fontface = 'bold', fontfamily = 'Helvetica', size = 12)

  ggsave(fig_file, plot = p_out, height = 6.6, width = 17, units = 'cm', dpi = 300)
}
knitr::include_graphics(fs::path_rel(fig_file))
```

### Map of absolute extirp/colonization

```{r absolute extirp and colonization}
fig_file <- here('ms_figs/figS4_spp_fe_turnover_components_absolute.png')

# if(!file.exists(fig_file)) {

  stat_to_rast <- function(df, s) {
    r <- df |> 
      fsubset(stat == s) |> 
      cell_id_to_xy() |> 
      rast(crs = 'epsg:4326') |> 
      project(spp_turn_r)
    return(r)
  }
  spp_turnover <- arrow::read_parquet(here('_output/spp_turnover_maps', 
                                          'all_spp_community_change.parquet'))        
  spp_extirp_r <- spp_turnover |> 
    stat_to_rast('extirpation')
  spp_colon_r  <- spp_turnover |> 
    stat_to_rast('colonization')

  fe_turnover  <- arrow::read_parquet(here('_output/fe_turnover_maps', 
                                          'all_fe_community_change.parquet'))
  fe_extirp_r <- fe_turnover |> 
    stat_to_rast('extirpation')
  fe_colon_r  <- fe_turnover |> 
    stat_to_rast('colonization')

  ### set up pipeline to turn individual maps into a grid
  turnover_rasts <- c(
      spp_extirp_r[['rcp45_2050']], spp_colon_r[['rcp45_2050']],  
      fe_extirp_r[['rcp45_2050']],  fe_colon_r[['rcp45_2050']], 
      spp_extirp_r[['rcp85_2050']], spp_colon_r[['rcp85_2050']],  
      fe_extirp_r[['rcp85_2050']],  fe_colon_r[['rcp85_2050']]) |> 
    setNames(rep('var', 8))
  
  fill_names <- c('$\\Delta \\, N_{Spp}$', '$\\Delta \\, N_{Spp}$',
                  '$\\Delta \\, N_{FE}$',  '$\\Delta \\, N_{FE}$',
                  '$\\Delta \\, N_{Spp}$', '$\\Delta \\, N_{Spp}$',
                  '$\\Delta \\, N_{FE}$',  '$\\Delta \\, N_{FE}$')

  rast_to_plot <- function(i) {
    r <- turnover_rasts[[i]]
    x <- as.data.frame(r, xy = TRUE)
    fill_name <- fill_names[i]
    p <- plot_map(data = x, fill_var = var, lat_color = 'grey70') +
      scale_fill_viridis_c() +
      theme(text = element_text(family = 'Helvetica'),
            legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
            legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
            ### shrink colorbar and tighten legend spacing
            legend.key.size = unit(0.3, 'cm'),
            legend.key.height = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
            legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
            legend.box.spacing = unit(2, 'pt'),
            axis.text = element_blank(), 
            axis.title = element_blank()) +
      labs(fill = latex2exp::TeX(fill_name))
  }

  p_list <- lapply(1:8, rast_to_plot)

  ### Layout in fractions of the full canvas: strips on the left (row labels)
  ### and top (column titles); each cell = panel + legend, with a thin strip
  ### above each panel
  left_w   <- 0.04
  top_h    <- 0.01
  col_w    <- (1 - left_w) / 2
  row_h    <- (1 - top_h) / 4
  panel_w  <- 0.40
  legend_w <- col_w - panel_w
  letter_h <- 0.03
  panel_h  <- row_h - letter_h

  ### Panels (legend removed so all panels share identical dimensions) and
  ### legends (extracted separately) are placed on the canvas by hand
  p_out <- ggdraw()
  for(i in 1:8) {
    row_i  <- (i - 1) %/% 2
    col_i  <- (i - 1) %% 2
    x0     <- left_w + col_i * col_w
    y0     <- 1 - top_h - (row_i + 1) * row_h  # bottom of cell

    panel  <- p_list[[i]] + theme(legend.position = 'none')
    legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p_list[[i]])

    p_out <- p_out +
      draw_plot(panel,  x = x0, y = y0, width = panel_w, height = panel_h) +
      draw_plot(legend, x = x0 + panel_w, y = y0, width = legend_w, height = panel_h) +
      draw_label(LETTERS[i], x = x0 -.001, y = y0 + panel_h,
                 hjust = 1, vjust = 1, fontfamily = 'Helvetica',
                 fontface = 'bold', size = 10)
  }

  ### Row labels (left) and column titles (top)
  row_labs <- c('Spp', 'FE', 'Spp', 'FE')
  for(r in 1:4) {
    p_out <- p_out +
      draw_label(row_labs[r], x = left_w / 2,
                 y = 1 - top_h - (r - 1) * row_h - letter_h - panel_h / 2,
                 angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5,
                 fontfamily = 'Helvetica', size = 8)
  }
  p_out <- p_out +
    draw_label('Extirpation',  x = left_w + panel_w / 2, y = 1 - top_h / 2,
               hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, fontfamily = 'Helvetica', size = 8) +
    draw_label('Colonization', x = left_w + col_w + panel_w / 2, y = 1 - top_h / 2,
               hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, fontfamily = 'Helvetica', size = 8)
 
  ggsave(fig_file, plot = p_out, height = 13, width = 17, units = 'cm', dpi = 300)
# }
knitr::include_graphics(fs::path_rel(fig_file))
```
